name: Estampes
description: MCP server for ChatGPT: you and GPT point at, draw on and link the same images.

ESTAMPES_ACCESS_KEY.description: Shared secret, generated for you. Connect ChatGPT to https://<app>.herokuapp.com/mcp?key=<this value> (see Settings → Config Vars). Clear it only for an open test server.

PUBLIC_BASE_URL.description: Optional. Public https address of this app, used for download links. Empty = taken from incoming requests.

ESTAMPES_CACHE_MB.description: Memory for decoded images. Keep well under the dyno's RAM (512 MB on Eco/Basic).
